requests.name: character
requests.description: One full-body friendly mint hooded little GameNight player mascot, standing facing right, side-view platformer sprite. Simple cream face, dark expressive eyes, mint outfit, tiny sprout on hood, dark shoes. Match reference character proportions. Isolated character only; no floor, no props, no shadows on ground. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters. Maintain a clearly separated face region for custom avatars.

requests.name: tv
requests.description: One front-facing large flat-screen television on two little feet, cozy dark navy bezel and blank charcoal screen. Isolated game prop, straight-on side-scroller elevation, no perspective, no cabinet, no room, no characters, no text, no background. Match the cozy living-room pixel style of the reference.

requests.name: platform
requests.description: Warm honey oak wooden platform for a cozy living-room side-scroller. Straight strong golden top edge, dark brown underside, simple broad pixel clusters, sparse wood grain, clear left and right end caps, no plants or objects.

requests.name: walk
requests.action: Walk cycle in place facing right, friendly energetic little steps, same body size, no camera movement, feet at a stable baseline.

requests.name: sleep
requests.action: Fall asleep: slowly crouch and sit down, close eyes, head gently droops. Keep the same mint hooded character and sprout. No props or text.

requests.name: wake
requests.action: Wake up from sitting asleep on the floor: open eyes, stretch arms and stand upright, facing right. Preserve mint hood and sprout. No text or props.
